      • setFileCategory

        @PublishedMethod
void setFileCategory(EInputFileCategory value)
        Sets the file category for this input file. The available file categories can be retrieved with getAvailableFileCategories(). This method call overwrites all already set file categories.
        Use setFileCategory(EInputFileCategory) to set one file category. This overwrites all already set file categories.
        Parameters:
        value -

      • setFileCategory

        @PublishedMethod
void setFileCategory(java.util.List<EInputFileCategory> value)
        Sets the file categories for this input file. The available file categories can be retrieved with getAvailableFileCategories(). This method call overwrites all already set file categories.
        Use setFileCategory(List) to set one or multiple file categories. This overwrites all already set file categories.
        Parameters:
        value -

      • setImportDidsAndRids

        @PublishedMethod
void setImportDidsAndRids(java.lang.Boolean value)
        Sets the ImportDissAndRids option.
        Use setImportDidsAndRids(Boolean) to import DIDs and RIDs as single signal for DCM (backward compatibility). This settings is only necessary for diagnostic data input files.
        Parameters:
        value -
